repos.description: A collection of MCP servers.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome MCP Servers 是一个精心策划的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器集合，涵盖文件访问、数据库连接、API集成等场景，支持本地与云端服务。项目提供多语言 README 和活跃社区支持，并配有在线目录与测试工具，助力开发者快速集成 AI 能力至各类应用。
repos.summary_en: Awesome MCP Servers is a curated collection of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers enabling secure AI interactions with local and remote resources. It includes production-ready and experimental servers for file access, databases, APIs, and more, with multilingual documentation, community support, and integrated testing tools via glama.ai.

repos.description: Open-source AI gateway. Self-hosted LLM gateway with OpenAI-, Claude- and Gemini-compatible APIs, model routing, access control, usage tracking and cost accounting.
repos.summary_zh: New API 是一个统一的 AI 模型聚合与分发平台，支持将各类大语言模型转换为 OpenAI、Claude 和 Gemini 兼容格式，提供个人与企业级的中心化模型管理网关。
repos.summary_en: New API is a unified AI model hub for aggregation and distribution, supporting cross-conversion of various LLMs into OpenAI-compatible, Claude-compatible, or Gemini-compatible formats. It serves as a centralized gateway for personal and enterprise model management.

repos.description: LLM API 管理 & 分发系统，支持 OpenAI、Azure、Anthropic Claude、Google Gemini、DeepSeek、字节豆包、ChatGLM、文心一言、讯飞星火、通义千问、360 智脑、腾讯混元等主流模型，统一 API 适配，可用于 key 管理与二次分发。单可执行文件，提供 Docker 镜像，一键部署，开箱即用。LLM API management & key redistribution system, unifying multiple providers under a single API. Single binary, Docker-ready, with an English UI.
repos.summary_zh: One API 是一个统一的 LLM API 管理与分发系统，支持 OpenAI、Azure、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、文心一言等数十家主流大模型，通过标准 OpenAI API 格式统一接入，实现密钥管理、负载均衡与二次分发。提供单可执行文件部署、Docker 镜像及英文 Web UI，开箱即用，适用于企业级多模型集成场景。
repos.summary_en: One API is a unified LLM API management and distribution system that supports over 20 mainstream models including OpenAI, Azure, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and Baidu's Wenxin. It standardizes access via OpenAI-compatible APIs, enabling key management, load balancing, and redistribution. Deployable as a single binary or Docker image with an English web interface, it offers out-of-the-box functionality for enterprise multi-model integration.

repos.description: 🚀 Next Gen Multi-tenant AI One-Stop Solution. Builtin Admin & Billing System. Enterprise-Grade Unified LLM Gateway Support for 200+ Models And 35+ Providers, Load Balacing w/ Priority-base Routing, Cost Management, Chat Share, Cloud Sync, Credit/Subscription Billing, All File Parsing, Web Search, Built-in Model Cache.
repos.summary_zh: CoAI.Dev 是一款企业级多租户 AI 一站式解决方案，支持 200+ 模型与 35+ 服务商接入，内置统一 LLM 网关、负载均衡、成本管理与订阅计费系统。具备跨平台 UI、文件解析、Web 搜索、PWA 桌面应用及完整后台管理功能，适用于企业私有化部署与商业化运营。
repos.summary_en: CoAI.Dev is a next-generation multi-tenant AI platform offering unified access to 200+ models across 35+ providers, with built-in billing, load balancing, file parsing, web search, and enterprise-grade admin dashboard. Designed for scalable SaaS deployment and commercial AI service delivery.

repos.description: Open-source Claude Design alternative. One-click import your Claude Code / Codex API key. Prompt → prototype / slides / PDF. Multi-model (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, GLM, Ollama). BYOK, local-first, MIT.
repos.summary_zh: Open CoDesign 是一款开源的 Claude Design 替代工具，支持一键导入 Claude Code/Codex API 密钥，将提示词转换为原型、幻灯片或 PDF。支持多模型（Claude/GPT/Gemini/Kimi/GLM/Ollama），采用 BYOK 和本地优先架构，MIT 许可，适合 AI 驱动的设计自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: Open CoDesign is an open-source alternative to Claude Design that converts prompts into polished prototypes, slides, or PDFs using your own API keys. Supports multi-model (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, GLM, Ollama), BYOK, and local-first architecture with MIT license for AI-powered design automation.

repos.description: ChatGPT官网接口纯协议的逆向实现，支持GPT-Image-2模型、文本模型，兼容OpenAI接口协议，在线批量生图/编辑图，号池管理，支持可编辑PPT/PSD文件逆向，支持导入CPA、sub2api号池 、支持接入Cherry  Studio、New Api 等软件
repos.summary_zh: ChatGPT2API 是对 ChatGPT 官网能力逆向封装的 OpenAI 兼容 API 代理，支持文生图、图片编辑与多图组图功能，集成号池管理、多种账号导入方式及 Docker 自托管部署，提供完整的在线画图工作台与缓存机制。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT2API is an OpenAI-compatible API proxy that reverse-engineers ChatGPT's image generation and editing capabilities, featuring account pool management, multi-import methods, Docker deployment, and a built-in online drawing workspace with caching support.

repos.description: Gemini polling proxy service （gemini轮询代理服务）
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Balance 是一个基于 FastAPI 的 Gemini API 代理与负载均衡服务，支持多密钥轮询、OpenAI 格式兼容、图像文本对话、网页搜索及实时状态监控，提供灵活的配置管理和详细的日志追踪。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Balance is a FastAPI-based proxy and load balancer for Google's Gemini API, enabling multi-key polling, OpenAI API compatibility, image-text chat, web search, and real-time key status monitoring with dynamic configuration and detailed logging.

repos.description: Simulates Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Qwen Code, and Kiro client requests, compatible with the OpenAI API. It supports thousands of Gemini model requests per day and offers free use of the built-in Claude model in Kiro. Easily connect to any client via the API, making AI development more efficient!
repos.summary_zh: AIClient-2-API 是一个强大的 API 代理服务，能够将原本仅限客户端使用的大模型（如 Gemini CLI、Antigravity、Qwen Code、Kiro 等）的请求统一转换为兼容 OpenAI 协议的标准接口。支持每日数千次 Gemini 模型请求，内置 Claude 免费调用功能，提供高可用性的模块化架构，包含账户池管理、智能轮询、自动故障转移和健康检查机制，显著提升 AI 开发效率。
repos.summary_en: AIClient-2-API is a powerful proxy service that unifies requests from client-restricted large models (e.g., Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Qwen Code, Kiro) into a standard OpenAI-compatible interface. It supports thousands of daily Gemini model requests, offers free built-in Claude access, and features a modular architecture with account pooling, intelligent polling, automatic failover, and health checks for 99.9% uptime, greatly enhancing AI development efficiency.

repos.description: DeepSeek-Compatible Middleware Interface: A technical exploration project in Go, focusing on high-concurrency protocol adaptation. It serves as a reference implementation for converting diverse web protocols into standardized formats.
repos.summary_zh: DS2API 是一个高性能 DeepSeek Web 对话能力转换 API，支持 OpenAI、Claude 和 Gemini 兼容接口。采用 Go 全量实现后端，React 构建管理后台，具备多账号轮询、PoW 验证、Tool Calling 防泄漏处理等核心功能，支持 Docker、Vercel 等多种部署方式，并提供完整的后台管理系统。
repos.summary_en: DS2API is a high-performance API that converts DeepSeek Web chat capabilities into OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini compatible interfaces. Built with full Go backend implementation and React admin UI, it features multi-account polling, PoW verification, Tool Calling protection, and supports deployment via Docker/Vercel. Includes complete management system with account testing and configuration sync.

repos.description: One Hub All LLMs For You | 为个人打造的 LLM API 聚合网关
repos.summary_zh: Octopus 是一款为个人用户设计的 LLM API 聚合服务，支持多通道接入、智能负载均衡与协议转换。具备统一密钥管理、自动模型同步、价格追踪及多数据库支持（SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL），提供美观的 Web 管理面板和全面的请求分析功能，实现高效稳定的 AI 接口统一管理。
repos.summary_en: Octopus is a personal LLM API aggregation service that unifies multiple provider channels with intelligent load balancing and protocol conversion. It supports multi-key management, automatic model/pricing sync, comprehensive analytics, and elegant UI, with multi-database support (SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL) for stable and efficient AI interface management.

repos.description: 让 QwenLM 物尽其用
repos.summary_zh: Qwen-Proxy 是一个将通义千问官方平台（chat.qwen.ai、Qwen Code/CLI）转换为 OpenAI API 兼容接口的代理服务，支持多账户轮询、流式响应、多模态及256K长上下文。通过统一API格式，用户可无缝对接各类OpenAI客户端调用通义千问模型，并提供Web管理界面与代理池集成方案应对高并发限速问题。
repos.summary_en: Qwen-Proxy is a proxy service that converts QwenLM's official platforms (chat.qwen.ai, Qwen Code/CLI) into OpenAI-compatible APIs. It supports multi-account polling, streaming responses, multimodal capabilities, and 256K context via CLI endpoints. Seamlessly integrates with OpenAI clients while offering a web admin interface and proxy pool integration for high-concurrency scenarios.

repos.description: 支持 AnyRouter、AgentRouter 的多平台多账号签到，理论兼容所有基于 NewAPI、OneAPI 的平台。
repos.summary_zh: AnyRouter 多账号自动签到工具，支持 AnyRouter 和 AgentRouter 平台，兼容 NewAPI/OneAPI 架构。通过 GitHub Actions 实现定时自动签到，支持多账号并行处理、WAF 绕过及机器人通知，配置灵活且维护良好。
repos.summary_en: A multi-account auto check-in tool for AnyRouter and AgentRouter platforms, compatible with NewAPI/OneAPI architectures. Uses GitHub Actions for scheduled automation, supports parallel account processing, WAF bypass, and notification alerts with flexible configuration.

repos.description: OpenAI 接口聚合管理，我们致力于提供优质的API接入服务，让您可以轻松集成先进的AI模型至您的产品和服务。
repos.summary_zh: Chat API 是基于 One API 和 New API 二次开发的 OpenAI 接口聚合管理系统，提供多模型接入、令牌分组计费、渠道标签化管理及 WxPusher 推送通知等功能，支持 Docker/宝塔一键部署，适用于企业级 AI 服务集成。
repos.summary_en: Chat API is a secondary development of One API and New API, serving as an OpenAI interface aggregation management system. It offers multi-model access, token-based billing, channel tagging, WxPusher notifications, and supports Docker/Baota one-click deployment for enterprise-level AI service integration.

repos.description: 一站式Exa注册机+号池轮询+API服务反代+多用户管理
repos.summary_zh: ExaFree 是一个 Exa API 代理与管理平台，支持多账号轮询、用户级 API Key 管理、Linux DO OAuth2 登录注册。提供完整的 API 代理服务（search/answer/contents 等）、MCP 工具集成、管理面板及数据库备份功能，采用 Docker 部署，支持 SQLite/PostgreSQL 持久化存储。
repos.summary_en: ExaFree is an Exa API proxy and management platform supporting multi-account polling, user-level API key management, and Linux DO OAuth2 login/registration. It provides full API proxy services (search/answer/contents), MCP tool integration, admin panel, and database backup features via Docker with SQLite/PostgreSQL support.

repos.description: Cloudflare Worker; Claude Code; Proxy; Easy to deploy; Claude Code Router; claude-code-router; ccr; alternate
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Cloudflare Worker 的 Claude Code 代理工具，支持将 Gemini 和 OpenAI 等第三方大模型 API 转换为 Claude 格式，实现零配置快速部署。核心特性包括流式响应、工具调用支持，并可通过 One-Balance 实现低成本 Claude Code 使用。
repos.summary_en: This project is a Cloudflare Worker-based proxy that converts third-party LLM APIs (Gemini, OpenAI) into Claude-compatible format, enabling zero-config deployment. It supports streaming/non-streaming responses, tool calls, and integrates with One-Balance for cost-effective Claude Code usage.

repos.description: 这是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的 TypeScript 项目，它充当一个代理服务器，能够将 Claude API 格式的请求无缝转换为 OpenAI API 格式。这使得任何与 Claude API 兼容的客户端（例如官方的 @anthropic-ai/claude-code CLI）都能够与任何支持 OpenAI API 格式的服务进行通信，如 Google Gemini, Groq, Ollama 等。
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的 TypeScript 代理服务器，可将 Claude API 请求无缝转换为 OpenAI API 格式，支持动态路由至 Google Gemini、Groq、Ollama 等兼容服务，具备全功能 API 兼容、函数调用转换、Haiku 模型快捷配置及一键部署脚本，实现 Claude 客户端与多 AI 服务的无缝互通。
repos.summary_en: This is a TypeScript project deployed on Cloudflare Workers that acts as a proxy server, seamlessly converting Claude API requests to OpenAI API format. It enables any Claude-compatible client (e.g., @anthropic-ai/claude-code) to communicate with OpenAI-compatible services like Google Gemini, Groq, and Ollama via dynamic routing, full API compatibility, tool calling conversion, and one-click deployment.

repos.description: ⚠️ 封号风控升级，请勿大量使用 / High ban risk, personal testing only 🚨 Use at your own risk.
repos.summary_zh: Kiro Stack 是一个将 Amazon Kiro（原 Q Developer）账号转换为 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容 API 的代理系统，结合 kiro-go 的管理面板与 kiro-gateway 的稳定转发能力，支持多账号池、自动 Token 刷新和双端点容错，适用于 Cursor、Claude Code 等 IDE 集成。
repos.summary_en: Kiro Stack is a proxy system that converts Amazon Kiro (formerly Q Developer) accounts into OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs. It combines kiro-go's web admin panel with kiro-gateway's stable request handling, featuring multi-account pools, auto-token refresh, and dual-endpoint fallback for use in IDEs like Cursor and Claude Code.

repos.summary_zh: Orchids-2api 是一个基于 Go 语言开发的 Claude API 代理服务器，支持多账号管理与负载均衡转发，具备故障转移、模型映射、工具调用及流式响应等核心能力，提供 Web 管理界面与完整调试日志，适用于企业级 Claude API 接入场景。
repos.summary_en: Orchids-2api is a Go-based API proxy server that enables multi-account management and load balancing for Claude API requests. It supports fault tolerance, model mapping, tool use, streaming responses via SSE, token counting, detailed logging, and includes a web admin interface for account management.

repos.description: OpenAI中转
repos.summary_zh: 本项目将 Cursor 编辑器的 AI 能力转换为 OpenAI API 兼容接口，支持通过 Bearer Token 认证调用聊天补全功能。用户只需提供 WorkosCursorSessionToken 即可在其他应用中复用 Cursor 的 AI 服务，适用于集成开发、自动化脚本等场景。
repos.summary_en: This project converts Cursor editor's AI capabilities into an OpenAI-compatible API interface, enabling reuse of Cursor's AI functionality in other applications. It supports chat completion via Bearer Token authentication using WorkosCursorSessionToken, ideal for integration and automation use cases.

repos.description: 让 Grok Chat 物尽其用
repos.summary_zh: grok-proxy 是一个基于 Go 的代理服务，将 Grok Chat 网页接口转换为 OpenAI API 兼容格式，支持流式/非流式响应、多模态图片输入、联网搜索及思考模式。用户通过 SSO Cookie 认证调用，支持 SOCKS5 代理池轮询，提供 Docker 快速部署和自定义配置能力。
repos.summary_en: grok-proxy is a Go-based proxy service that converts Grok Chat's web interface into an OpenAI API-compatible format. It supports streaming/non-streaming responses, multimodal image input, web search, and reasoning mode. Authentication via SSO cookie, with optional SOCKS5 proxy pool rotation. Offers Docker deployment, model selection, and custom configuration via environment variables.

repos.description: 简易版api集合器
repos.summary_zh: UniAPI 是一个兼容 OpenAI 协议的 API 转发器，支持多密钥管理与模型择优机制，自动选择高成功率、低延迟的服务商。集成断路器机制防止异常服务雪崩，优化流式响应展示效果，适用于 Azure OpenAI、Claude 等兼容服务，提供安全的 Bearer Token 认证与 Vercel 一键部署。
repos.summary_en: UniAPI is an OpenAI-compatible API proxy that manages multiple API keys and selects optimal providers based on 72-hour success rate and latency. It includes a circuit breaker to prevent cascading failures and optimizes streaming responses for better UX, supporting Azure OpenAI, Claude, and other compatible services with secure Bearer Token auth and Vercel deployment.

repos.description: 一个用于 New API 的可嵌入状态页面，支持展示服务状态、可用性和监控信息。
repos.summary_zh: New API Status Embed 是一个专为 new-api 设计的可嵌入状态监控页面，通过拉取管理日志接口数据，按模型和时间窗口聚合展示服务可用性。支持 iframe 嵌入、多时间粒度切换、自动刷新及模型白名单过滤，适用于独立状态子站或主站集成。
repos.summary_en: New API Status Embed is an embeddable status dashboard for new-api that aggregates request logs by model and time window. It provides real-time service availability monitoring with iframe support, customizable time ranges, auto-refresh, and model whitelisting, ideal for standalone status pages or integration into main sites.

repos.description: 🚀 New API 智能价格同步工具 - 解决自定义模型前缀导致的价格同步失效问题。智能推断上游基础价，一键同步模型价格。
repos.summary_zh: PriceSyncPro 是一款专为 New API 设计的浏览器插件，解决自定义模型前缀导致的价格同步失效问题。通过智能推断上游基础价、自动适配 New API 和 One Hub 数据源，支持一键创建渠道/供货商/模型配置或批量更新价格，全程无需手动 SQL 操作，显著提升价格管理效率。
repos.summary_en: PriceSyncPro is a browser plugin designed for New API to resolve price sync failures caused by custom model prefixes. It intelligently infers upstream base prices, auto-adapts to New API and One Hub data sources, enabling one-click channel/supplier/model setup or bulk price updates without manual SQL operations, significantly streamlining price management.
